definitions.explanation: The residence of an emperor or empress. In Japan, specifically the palace of the Japanese emperor.

examples.japanese: {皇宮|こうぐう}{警察|けいさつ}が{警備|けいび}している。
examples.english: The Imperial Guard Police are providing security.

examples.japanese: {皇宮|こうぐう}の{周|まわ}りをジョギングする{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many people jog around the imperial palace.

examples.japanese: {皇宮|こうぐう}{護衛官|ごえいかん}は{天皇|てんのう}{陛下|へいか}や{皇族|こうぞく}の{身辺|しんぺん}{警護|けいご}を{担当|たんとう}する{特別|とくべつ}な{警察官|けいさつかん}だ。
examples.english: Imperial Palace guards are special police officers responsible for the personal security of the Emperor and the Imperial Family.

notes:
A compound of {皇|こう} (emperor, imperial) and {宮|ぐう} (palace). While {皇居|こうきょ} is the standard term for the current Imperial Palace in Tokyo, {皇宮|こうぐう} appears in official titles and compound terms, particularly in the name of the {皇宮警察|こうぐうけいさつ} (Imperial Guard Police).

The {皇宮警察|こうぐうけいさつ} is a special police force under the National Police Agency that guards the Imperial Palace and protects the Imperial Family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {皇宮|こうぐう}{警察|けいさつ}: Imperial Guard Police
- {皇宮|こうぐう}{護衛官|ごえいかん}: Imperial Palace guard
- {皇宮|こうぐう}{警備|けいび}: Imperial Palace security

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {皇居|こうきょ}: the Imperial Palace (Tokyo) — the standard modern term for the Emperor's residence
- {宮殿|きゅうでん}: palace — general term for any grand royal or imperial palace
- {御所|ごしょ}: imperial residence — used for both the Kyoto Imperial Palace and as a respectful term
